notes: Only the last 60 days of orders are readable by default. Anything older needs the read_all_orders scope, which Shopify grants on request.
sortKey defaults to PROCESSED_AT here rather than ID, so results come back in a different order than a naive REST port expects.
REST status, financial_status and fulfillment_status parameters become terms inside the query string.
Money is a MoneyBag with shopMoney and presentmentMoney, not the single string REST returned.
The 60 day limit applies here too. An order older than that returns null unless the app holds read_all_orders.
Line items are a connection, so they need their own first argument and page beyond it. REST returned them inline.
order_number becomes name, which includes the store's order prefix.
This covers email, shipping address, tags, note and metafields only.
Changing line items, quantities or discounts is not possible here. That is an order edit, which begins with its own mutation and is a different flow from anything REST offered.
